THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land in extent of 0.6662 Hectare, depicted of Lots‘A’ to ‘F’ in the Advance Tracing No. CO/MRT/2016/810 and dated16.06.2017, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Villageof Egoda Uyana of Divisional Secretariat Moratuwa, ColomboDistrict in the Western Province:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Extent: 0.0302 HectareNorth: Land of which the Assmt. No. and the owner can not befound at Modara Road; East: Road; South: Lots B, C and D; West:Sea.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Lansiyawatta – Extent: 0.5420 HectareNorth: Lot A, D and E; East: Land of which the Assmt. No. andthe owner can not be found at Modara Road, the land claimed by M.Cuter Fernando bearing Assmt. No. 310/15 at Modara Road, landclaimed by Anee Panateeshiya bearing Assmt. No. 310/17 at ModaraRoad, land claimed by S. Nelson Fernando bearing Assmt. No.310/18 at Modara Road, T. Chandana Peiris bearing Assmt. Assmt. No. and the owner can not be found at Modara Road; West:Land of which the Assmt. No. and the owner can not be found atModara Road and the Sea.
03. Lot ‘C’ – Extent: 0.0013 HectareNorth: Lot A; East: Lot B; South: Lot E; West: Lot D.
04. Lot ‘D’ – Lansiyawatta – Extent: 0.0151 HectareNorth: Lot A; East: Lot C; South: Lot E; West: Lot B.
05. Lot ‘E’ – Lansiyawatta – Extent: 0.0180 HectareNorth: Lot D; East, South and West: Lot B.
06. Lot ‘F’ – Extent: 0.0596 HectareNorth: Sea; East: Land of which the Assmt. No. and the owner cannot be found at Modara Road; South and West: Sea.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
